_comment: Every number that tunes the game: chances, timers, payouts, caps, costs. Read through Balance (Balance.f/i/a with a 'section.name' key). `v` is the value; `note` says what it is and where it came from. Change numbers here, never in code; tools/balance_lint.py checks every key is used and every use has a key, and tools/balance_sim.tscn shows what a change does.

fuel_tank.note: Fuel the tank holds when full.

fuel_regen_seconds.note: the tank slowly refills: 1 fuel every 10 minutes

fuel_tank_gem_cost.note: Gems to refill the tank at once.

tractor_coin_chance.note: coins pop out of the ground while a vehicle plows

tractor_coins.note: Coins in one pop-out while a vehicle plows (see tractor_coin_chance).

fuel_find_chance.note: FarmVille: plowing your own farm can turn up fuel, once a day

mystery_box_gem_cost.note: Gems to buy a Mystery Box.

material_gems.note: gems for one building material (FarmVille: 1 Farm Cash each)

limit_vehicle.note: one of each, wherever it is: standing on the farm or parked in a Garage

limit_decor.note: How many of one decoration a farm may hold (effectively unlimited).

limit_living.note: animals, trees, blooms and the like

default_limit.note: buildings of one kind a farm may have, for now

bunch_days.note: a placed Perfect Bunch lasts 14 days

fast_crop_seconds.note: A crop that grows in less than this counts as fast for mastery targets (6 hours).

crop_points_fast.note: harvests for each of a fast crop's three stars (6 hours or less)

crop_points_medium.note: for a crop that grows in under a day

crop_points_slow.note: for a crop that grows a day or more

producer_points_daily.note: collections for each star of a tree or animal ready every day or sooner (FarmVille: an animal's first star took about 3 to 9)

producer_points_two_days.note: for one ready every two days

fertilized_points.note: mastery points a fertilized crop's harvest counts for (a plain one counts 1)

stray_min_gap.note: a new stray turns up 36 to 60 hours after the last (about three a week; it was 3 to 6 hours, owner 19 Nov: far too often)

stray_max_gap.note: The longest wait, in seconds, before a new stray turns up after the last (60 hours).

week_most.note: at most this many strays turn up in any 7 days (owner 19 Nov)

stray_stays.note: a stray nobody adopts wanders off after a day

adopt_feeds.note: feedings a stray needs to be adopted: one unit each of a feed its kind eats, from the Barn (FarmVille's adoption task)

lost_weight.note: each lost animal's share of the stray pool (a 100-coin animal is 1.0)

bushel_chance.note: a harvest drops a bushel of its crop, once you own a crafting building

bushel_cap.note: bushels held at once (FarmVille's stall held 100)

stall_crops.note: the Farmers Market offers this many crops a day

stall_each.note: 3 bushels of each, like 3 a day from each neighbour in FarmVille

craft_xp_per_star.note: XP added per star of the recipe (so 22 to 58; FarmVille gave 50 a product).

produce_chance.note: each animal, hive, tree or bloom collected drops its produce (milk, eggs, apples, roses) this often, once you own a crafting building. Higher than a bushel's: they are collected far less often than plots are harvested.

craft_hours_by_star.note: how long a recipe takes, by the star that unlocks it (FarmVille: 6 hours for all). Short first recipes keep a new building busy; the best take a night.

craft_xp_base.note: XP for a craft, before its star's share.

lamb_chance.note: Sheep Pen harvest with a ram inside

piglet_chance.note: Pig Pen harvest with a boar inside

calf_chance.note: Dairy Farm harvest with a bull inside

fertilizer_chance.note: Dairy Farm harvest drops a bag of fertilizer

foal_chance.note: Horse Stable harvest with a stallion inside

stable_helper_chance.note: Stable harvest: a farmhand, and separately an arborist

stable_xp_chance.note: Stable harvest with a stallion: 100 XP

stable_xp.note: XP prize from a Horse Stable harvest with a stallion (see stable_xp_chance).

perfect_bunch_chance.note: FarmVille: a flower harvest can give a Perfect Bunch

bunch_cap_no_shed.note: bunches kept without a Garden Shed

shed_free_bunches.note: FarmVille gave 10 bunches with the shed

streak.note: FarmVille's daily bonus: what each day in a row gives (coins, fertilizer, unwither, gems); the last day's repeats

daily_parts.note: Building parts in the daily gift.

slop_cost.note: Coins for a bucket of slop at the Pig Pen.

forage_seconds.note: How long pigs forage for truffles (8 hours).

pigs_per_truffle.note: Pigs needed in the pen for it to find truffles.

truffles_per_pig.note: Truffles a pig can find in one forage.

queen_gem_cost.note: Gems to buy a Queen Bee.

bee_chance.note: per flower harvest, only into a hive with a queen

pollination_per_bee.note: Pollination chance each bee adds (1 in 400).

max_pollination.note: The most the pollination chance can reach.

pollinated_lifetime.note: How long a pollinated plot stays pollinated (2 days).

bees_stay_days.note: away longer than this, bees start to leave

bees_leave_per_day.note: Share of a hive's bees that leave for each day away beyond bees_stay_days.

queen_stays_days.note: Away longer than this many days, a hive loses its queen.

supply_gems.note: gems one Watering Can, Animal Feed or Flower Food costs when none are left

seedling_share.note: An Orchard harvest gives a Mystery Seedling this often (otherwise a Watering Can).

rare_chance.note: a seedling from a tree with a rare variety grows into the rare one

mystery_baby_chance.note: per animal home harvest (our guess: FarmVille's pens varied)

home_feed_chance.note: an animal home's harvest leaves a sack of Animal Feed

nursery_feed.note: the Nursery Barn's harvest: FarmVille's nursery gave feed daily

bulb_chance.note: per Single Bloom harvest (doubled for a Full Bloom)

bloom_food_chance.note: a bloom's harvest leaves Flower Food

regrow_food.note: Flower Food to regrow a withered Single Bloom

golden_pity.note: guaranteed after this many harvests without one

collectible_chance.note: one item from the crop's collection

collectible_pity.note: Harvests without a collectible after which one is guaranteed.

bird_chance.note: a bird visits: one item from the bird collection

mastery_luck_bonus.note: per mastery star, multiplies golden and collectible chances

min_seconds.note: Away at least this long and the farm opens with a line on what ripened, withered or became ready meanwhile.

young_farm_days.note: a farm's first days in which it is helped once a day to plant (owner, 19 Nov: casual players were broke for four days)

young_farm_plots.note: plots a young farm is helped to plow and plant once a day, when it cannot afford them and has land bare

rescue_coins.note: Coins given to a player with nothing left to plant.

golden_coin_multiplier.note: A golden harvest pays this many times the coins.

golden_xp.note: Extra XP on a golden harvest.

fertilizer_cost.note: Coins for a bag of fertilizer.

bonus_xp.note: Extra XP on a bonus-XP harvest.

start_unwithers.note: Unwithers a new farm starts with.

pollinated_ripe_mult.note: pollinated crops stay ripe twice as long

collectible_action_chance.note: Chance per plow, plant or fertilize of finding a collectible.

animal_collectible_chance.note: collecting animals, trees and buildings (barnyard and orchard sets)

unwither_gem_cost.note: Gems for an Unwither when none are left.

fresh_farm_clear_seconds.note: a new farm starts in fair weather for this long

start_coins.note: Coins a new farm starts with.

start_gems.note: Gems a new farm starts with.

super_harvest_multiplier.note: A super harvest (a harvest or collect drop) pays this many times the coins.

coins_per_buy_xp.note: Coins spent for each XP a coin buy gives (FarmVille: 1 XP per 100 coins); gem buys give none.

coins_per_level.note: Coins for reaching a level, times the level reached (level 10 pays 1,000).

xp_per_level_after_table.note: XP for the first level beyond the level table.

xp_growth_after_table.note: and this much more for each level after it, so levels keep slowing as the farm earns more (the table grows about as fast)

mastery_price_bonus.note: a crop's price, per mastery star (MasterySystem has the stars)

level_xp.note: Total XP needed to reach level n is entry n-1. Tuned with tools/balance_sim: level 20 in about two weeks at three visits a day. Level 2 at 12 comes in the first visit (two ripe plots and about ten plowed), the first level-up a new player sees.

sell_markup.note: A 1-star good sells for its ingredients' worth times this.

fuel_base.note: Fuel a 1-star good is worth, before mastery.

fuel_per_star.note: Fuel added per recipe mastery star.

markup_per_star.note: Added to the markup per star above the first: a 4-star good sells for 2.5 times what went into it.

fuel_per_recipe_star.note: Fuel added per star of the recipe above the first.

markup_per_mastery_star.note: A good sells for this much more (a share of its price) per recipe mastery star.

sell_share.note: FarmVille sold anything back for 5% of its price

sell_coins_per_gem.note: our guess for items bought with gems

min_ripe_window.note: A ripe crop stays ripe at least this long (4 hours).

max_ripe_window.note: A ripe crop stays ripe at most this long (2 days).

wither_after.note: a Single Bloom left ready this long withers (FarmVille: 7 days)

block_seconds.note: One weather per block of this many seconds (3 hours).

ease_seconds.note: A block's weather fades in and out over this long at its edges.

correlation_blocks.note: How long weather persists: neighbouring blocks are alike within about this many blocks (4 = 12 hours). 1 is the old coin-flip-per-block; higher is steadier.

fog_hours.note: Fog only forms when a block begins in these local hours (early morning).

odds.note: Share of time each kind of weather is out, by season (weights). Fog only in the early morning; snow only in winter. Looks only: FarmVille had no weather.

enabled.note: 1 layout synergies on (our own touch, not FarmVille 2009), 0 off: touching homes of one kind pay no extra

home_boosts.note: 1 stocked homes boost the farm (data/home_boosts.json; our own touch), 0 off

enabled.note: 1 feeding on (our own touch, not FarmVille 2009), 0 off: no feed drops, no hunger, no effects

chance_base.note: chance a harvest of a feedable crop family drops one feed (estimate)

chance_per_star.note: more chance per mastery star on the crop

tree_chance.note: chance collecting a tree gives one Fruit

stock_cap.note: most of one feed the Barn holds

cap_per_barn_level.note: more of each feed per Barn upgrade level

overflow_coins.note: coins for a feed that finds the Barn full

animals_per_feed.note: animals one unit of feed feeds in a home

accepted_share.note: an accepted (not favourite) feed gives this share of the effect

rich_bonus.note: a Rich feed (from a golden, super or pollinated harvest) adds this share to the effect

hunger_penalty.note: share of the coins an unfed animal's collect loses (never all); 0.15 keeps a never-feeder within Part 4's 30% of a feeder's animal income (tools/balance_sim --no-feed: feeders reach x1.07-1.18 of the plain price; 0.3 lost 33-38%, 0.2 up to 32%)

produce_bonus.note: extra coins on the next collect, from a favourite feed chosen for produce

speed_bonus.note: share of the cycle cut off, from a favourite feed chosen for speed

rare_multiplier.note: times the chance of a rare find, from a favourite feed chosen for rare

enabled.note: 1 neighbours, gifts, requests and shares on (our own touch: an inbox where FarmVille had the feed), 0 off

gifts_per_neighbour_per_day.note: FarmVille: one free gift to each neighbour a day

helps_per_day.note: requests and shared seedlings you can help in a day (estimate)

inbox_limit.note: most things waiting in the inbox; newer ones are not delivered while full

mail_per_day.note: most things neighbours send in a day, answers to your own posts aside (owner, 19 Nov: 60 waited on a new farm)

outbox_limit.note: most of your own requests and shares open at once

post_hours.note: hours your request or share stays open before it lapses

slot_seconds.note: neighbours decide once per slot whether to send you something

slot_chance.note: chance a neighbour sends something in a slot, times their kindness (estimate)

catchup_hours.note: most time neighbours are simulated for after you were away

kind_gift.note: weight: a neighbour's mail is a gift

kind_request.note: weight: a neighbour's mail is a request for help

kind_share.note: weight: a neighbour's mail is a share

answer_min_seconds.note: quickest a neighbour answers your request, before their speed

answer_max_seconds.note: slowest a neighbour answers your request, before their speed

fuel_per_answer.note: fuel each neighbour sends when you ask for fuel

frame_ask_most.note: most of one material a frame asks neighbours for at once

seedling_waters.note: neighbours who water a shared seedling (each feeds it once)

thanks_coins.note: coins a neighbour sends back when they take something you shared or gave

thanks_chance.note: chance a neighbour thanks you for a gift (estimate)

enabled.note: 1 the seasons are on (scripts/season.gd, data/seasons.json; our own touch): the season follows the real calendar where the player lives, crops have home seasons, and rain waters the fields. 0: always summer, as before

from_level.note: crops planted below this level are never off-season: a new farm learns plain farming first

off_price_mult.note: an off-season crop sells for this many times its price (the seed shelf says so)

off_window_mult.note: and stays ripe this share of its usual time before it withers: more coins, less slack

rain_bonus.note: a crop it rained on while it grew sells for this much more (added with the fertilizer and mastery bonuses); the forecast under the clock says when rain is due

forecast_blocks.note: how many weather blocks ahead the forecast looks (8 x 3 h: a day)

run_scale.note: the notes a run of the same sound climbs (a swipe's plots, a streak of harvests), in semitones above the first; past the end the top note holds (autoload/feedback.gd). Our own touch.

streak_gap_seconds.note: the farmer's next job of the same kind within this long carries the streak on (scripts/farm_grid.gd); longer and the notes start again

produce.note: a harvested crop's picture pops out of the plot (rising `rise` px over `pop_seconds`, shown `px` across), hangs `hang_seconds`, then arcs `arc` px high to the coin counter in `fly_seconds`, landing at `land_scale`; `trail` gives it `sparks` soft sparks living `spark_seconds`, up to `spark_px` across (only where Quality fx_trails allows) (scripts/fx/fx_layer.gd). Wow build

combo_min.note: a streak of the same work at least this long says its count once, bigger, over the last plot when the farmer has no more of that work queued (the sweep's end: x8); 0 never (scripts/farm_grid.gd). Wow build

streak_shout_every.note: a streak says its count over the plot at every multiple of this (x5, x10...); 0 never

farmhouse_levels.note: the farmer's levels at which the farmhouse gains its next part (data/building_models.json farmhouse.levels 2, 3, 4)

idle_view_seconds.note: with no touch for this long the interface fades away and the farm plays on; the next touch brings it back and does nothing else (scripts/main.gd). 0 never

away_card_seconds.note: how long the While you were away card stays before it leaves by itself (scripts/hud/away_card.gd)

ready_check_seconds.note: how often the Next ready button counts what is ready (scripts/hud/hud_side.gd)

swipe_farm.note: 1 swipe to farm on (our own touch, not FarmVille 2009, which farmed one click a plot and left many plots at once to the vehicles): a one-finger drag with a swipe tool works every plot it crosses; 0 off: every drag pans

swipe_tools.note: the tools a swipe works plots with (scripts/farm_grid.gd); any other tool's drag pans

feed_per_baby.note: Animal Feed one baby in a nursery eats to grow up (FarmVille: a Mystery Baby took 10 Animal Feed); its trough takes this much per baby, no more

grown_xp.note: XP for each baby raised (ours; in place of the old nursery's spare-baby XP)

queue_max.note: jobs the farmer takes at once (taps or a swipe); on purpose: a whole field is a vehicle's work, as in FarmVille, and reaching it says so

level_points.note: VIP points each VIP level takes in all (docs/VIP.md): a free player who logs in every day is at the last in about twelve months

streak_points.note: VIP points the daily gift gives on the first day of a login streak, and more by as much each day in a row

streak_days.note: the day of the streak at which the daily VIP points stop growing (50 a day)

level_days.note: days of active VIP that come with each new VIP level

week_days.note: days of active VIP bought at once

week_gems.note: gems for those days, before the level's share

week_gems_per_level.note: gems more for those days at each VIP level (8 at VIP 1, 50 at VIP 15)

top_boost.note: what active VIP multiplies the buildings' bonuses and chances by at the top level; each level adds the same step from 1

level_days.note: days a utility building takes to gain a level of wear at its first size (docs/WEAR.md)

size_faster.note: how much faster a building wears for each size it has grown (more upgrades, more upkeep)

grace_days.note: days from a farm's start before anything wears

goods_less.note: share fewer coins a home gives a collect at each level of wear (at the last level, none)

craft_slower.note: share longer a craft takes at each level of the crafting building's wear (at the last level, none starts)

room_less.note: share less room in a storage building at each level of wear (nothing kept is thrown out)

spoil_from.note: the level of wear from which some of what a storage building keeps spoils

spoil_share.note: share of the feed (Barn) or bunches (Garden Shed) that spoils a day in worn storage

least_price.note: the price a repair is worked from for a building that cost less (the Barn was free)

repair_share.note: a repair's coins and materials at each level of wear, as a share of what the building and its sizes cost (owner: at most 40%); as many levels as entries, and at the last the building stops

repair_seconds.note: how long a building's repair takes at each level of wear

step_growth.note: how many times the coins of a building's next size are of the size before (docs/WEAR.md)

owned_more.note: share more every upgrade costs for each upgrade the farm already has (sizes and stars)

size_coins.note: a building's second size costs this share of its price in coins (its materials too); each size on, step_growth times more

level_days.note: days a vehicle parked in a Garage takes to gain a level of rust (docs/RUST.md)

outside_rate.note: times as fast a vehicle standing outside rusts (a level every 7 days)

fuel_more.note: more fuel a plot at each level of rust

area_less.note: share fewer plots a vehicle works at each level of rust (rounded down, never under one)

repair_share.note: the repair's coins at each level of rust, as a share of the vehicle's price; as many levels as there are entries, and at the last the vehicle does not work

repair_seconds.note: how long the repair takes at each level of rust

daily_coins_per.note: coins a collected daily job pays for each thing it asked for (Harvest 10 Strawberries pays 100)

daily_xp.note: XP a collected daily job pays

daily_full_level.note: the level at which today's jobs ask for the top of their range (data/goals.json daily.templates n); below it, a share

daily_crop_hours.note: a job to harvest a crop (@crop_quick) names only crops that ripen within this many hours, so a crop planted at a morning visit is ready by an evening one: the job can be done today

daily_play_hours.note: the span of a day's play: a job to collect from or feed animals (per_owned) asks at most what the farm's own animals give in it (each at least once)

most.note: phone notifications waiting at once, at most (owner, 19 Nov: few, never a flood)

gap.note: seconds at least between two notifications

quiet.note: local hours with no notification: one due then waits for the end (10 pm to 8 am)

wither_warning.note: seconds before a crop withers that its warning comes
